stemMarkdown: After its price was increased by 25%, an article costs Rs. 3125. What was its price (in Rs.) before the increase?
solutionMarkdown: If the original price is $x$, then $x \times \left(1 + \dfrac{25}{100}\right) = 3125$, so $x = \dfrac{3125 \times 100}{125} = 2500$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The new price is 125% of the old, so the old price is $\dfrac{100}{125}$ of Rs. 3125 $=$ Rs. 2500.
